estimand: Each character first-place probability, equally weighted across all selected maps, with complete six-rotation blocks as independent units

uncertainty.method: Map-stratified six-rotation vector resampling; max absolute deviation studentized by original cluster SE; independent primary/mixed cohorts; 97.5th-percentile max-t plus simultaneous 97.5% bounded-block fallback
uncertainty.caveat: Bootstrap coverage is approximate. Degenerate/one-block endpoints use conservative weighted Hoeffding bounds. Individual races and racers are never independent bootstrap observations.

eligibilityIssues: Primary: Requires at least 128 independent complete blocks per map
Training/exploratory data cannot certify held-out balance
Primary independent holdout seed domain is unverified
acceptance.scope: Statistical criteria only. Candidate freezing, untouched holdout provenance, identical-role controls, deterministic replay, archetype ordering, and source-integrity review require separate evidence.

warnings: Uncertainty is descriptive only: training/exploratory outcomes are not independent confirmation of a tuned candidate
40 degenerate/one-block endpoints use conservative bounded-block fallback, not a zero-width bootstrap interval

primary.name: baseline-corrected.jsonl.gz
primary.denominators: Win rates retain all six rotations in each complete block, including DNF/no-winner races. Raw diagnostics retain every input row. Finish-time summaries condition on finishers; lap-time summaries condition on recorded laps. Raw pooled diagnostics are not equal-map estimands.
